summary: Frontend-only test of DecisionOS admin console new features (Usage tab, workspace suspend/reactivate, outage alert banner, audit log) plus tenant owner regression. All admin UI features verified working. Sharma Textiles workspace was suspended and immediately reactivated as required. Regression: owner@sharma.com login works and dashboard loads (86 tasks visible).

Usage tab: 3 cards render (3 AI Calls, 31.9k Tokens, $0.11 Est Cost); per-workspace table shows Sharma Textiles row with 3 calls, 31.1k in, 790 out, $0.1051
Usage time-range buttons (today/7d/30d/all) all clickable, refetch without error; all show 3 calls in this env (all Sharma /ask calls fall inside today)

Sharma Textiles left in ACTIVE state (verified by owner login regression working)
Outage alert banner: absent in normal state (as expected, no forced key failure)

Audit Log tab shows new entries: 'Suspended workspace Sharma Textiles Pvt Ltd · SUSPEND TENANT' and 'Reactivated workspace Sharma Textiles Pvt Ltd · REACTIVATE TENANT' with correct timestamps and admin@decisionos.biz actor
All existing tabs render (Overview, AI Keys, Users, Health)
REGRESSION: owner@sharma.com / demo1234 logs in successfully, redirected to /inbox, dashboard renders with tasks + workspace name 'Sharma Textiles Pvt Ltd'
